subject.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout

question: Should PR #93655 land as the downstream stuck-recovery classification fix for active model-call stalls while preserving side-effecting tool stalls as non-replayable?
rationale: The patch appears mechanically coherent and sufficiently proven, but it intentionally changes session recovery and fallback semantics in a P1 agent runtime path, so maintainer ownership is needed before merge.

options.title: Land with owner signoff
options.body: Accept the PR's model-call versus side-effecting-tool boundary as the intended downstream recovery behavior once the exact head remains green.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery policy
options.body: Keep the PR open until #88870 and adjacent timeout-budget work define one complete stuck-recovery policy.

options.title: Require live channel/provider proof
options.body: Ask for an end-to-end live recovery run before changing fallback semantics, even though the production-module proof covers the local boundary.

recommendation.title: Land with owner signoff
recommendation.body: Accept the PR's model-call versus side-effecting-tool boundary as the intended downstream recovery behavior once the exact head remains green.
